description:
Every kernel compile error ends with "(defk <code>: docs/language.md#<code>)" (Defk.Errors, `@docs "docs/language.md#"`, and `docs/1`). docs/ contains only adr/, agents/ and beam-nifs.md; writing language.md is defk-sgw.1, still open. So the best-designed part of the devex (64 coded errors with rewrites) currently ends with a broken pointer, which the devex cold test (defk-sgw.3) will hit.

Two acceptable outcomes:
1. defk-sgw.1 lands with one anchor per code in Defk.Errors.codes/0 (the registry already has summary, why, hint, example and rewrite per code, so the reference section can be generated from it), plus a test that every code has an anchor in the file. This ticket then closes with it.
2. Until then, the footer points at something that exists: e.g. "(defk <code>; `mix run -e 'IO.puts Defk.Errors.explain!("<code>")'`)" with a small `explain!/1` that prints the registry entry, or simply "(defk <code>)" with the docs link added back when the file exists.

Recommended: do (2) now as a small change in Defk.Errors with a test that the rendered footer never names a path that is missing from the repo; keep the dependency on defk-sgw.1 for (1).

Done when: no rendered compile error references a file that does not exist in the repo, verified by a test.
title: Compile error footers link to docs/language.md, which does not exist yet
